title: Encoding a Quantified Boolean Formula
statement: A quantified Boolean formula consists of a finite list of quantifiers and a CNF matrix over variables indexed by the natural numbers. Its encoding is the pairing encoding of the list obtained by replacing each quantifier by its Boolean encoding and the serialization of its CNF matrix.
hypotheses_covered: A quantified Boolean formula with a finite quantifier list and a CNF matrix over natural-number-indexed variables
